verdict.rationale: Sentry documents a full self-hosted stack (develop.sentry.dev/self-hosted) with a 'minimal setup, no guarantees' caveat and even mentions relocation tooling for moving self-hosted→SaaS, implying some upgrade path awareness. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict a smooth production upgrade path: one team reports 'each release would unleash more containers and consume more memory until we couldn't run anything... except Sentry,' and several report abandoning self-hosted Sentry for lighter alternatives (GlitchTip, Bugsink) specifically due to upgrade/maintenance burden, while only one report calls it 'rock-solid.' Missing for 10: a documented, versioned upgrade/migration guide beyond generic install docs, and stronger independent confirmation that production upgrades are reliable at scale.
